title: Define constellation and labeling data model
description:
Introduce the core value types for constellation points, bit labels, normalization metadata, and modem capabilities so the framework has a shared representation for both arbitrary and built-in modems.

## Success Criteria

- [ ] Core types represent constellation points, per-symbol bit labels, and normalization metadata without embedding backend-specific assumptions.
- [ ] The data model can describe both arbitrary constellations and built-in square-QAM presets.
- [ ] Public invariants needed by builders and demappers are explicit in the API surface.

## Notes

This is the first leaf task under the modem core API story.
